label: Thin belief reason from actual-force concession and consideration presentation
description: Instantiation transcription. For the subject a and content p of the concession, the attributed consideration targets believe p. The reverse presentation implication at a,p yields Reason a p. Actual force, aim satisfaction and preference independence do no work in this projection. A general attitude about p does not supply the belief witness. F6 leaves p existential and does not identify p with the denial.
